issues.legal_issue: A municipal assessment review after the municipality has been superseded must be determined by a properly constituted statutory committee, rather than by the officer who made the assessment acting alone.
material_facts: After the municipality was superseded, the government appointed an officer to exercise powers that included making assessments and issued a later notification concerning the powers and duties of the statutory review committee.
That officer enhanced the valuation and assessment of the holding and then rejected the owner's application for review.
The review was not determined by a committee constituted with the membership required by the Act.
issues.conclusion: The officer's order rejecting the objections and enhancing the valuation and assessment was without jurisdiction.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 386(1)(b) and 117(1) of the Bihar and Orissa Municipal Act, 1922, government-appointed persons take the place of Commissioners for the Commissioners' powers and duties, including their role in constituting a review committee. The committee must still include the prescribed taxpayer members and government servant; section 386(1)(b) does not authorize the government to replace the committee itself with one officer. The provisions should be construed to keep the review procedure workable and avoid the same officer revising an assessment and sitting in judgment on it. No earlier cases are cited.

rule.if: municipal_assessment_review_proceeding and municipality_superseded and review_committee_not_properly_constituted and assessment_officer_alone_decided_review

predicates.municipal_assessment_review_proceeding: The proceeding concerns review of a municipal assessment.
predicates.municipality_superseded: The government had superseded the municipality.
predicates.review_committee_not_properly_constitute: The review was not heard and determined by a committee with the required membership.
predicates.assessment_officer_alone_decided_review: The officer who made or amended the assessment alone decided the review.

issues.definition: When a municipal assessment review follows the municipality's supersession and the required committee is not constituted, an assessment officer acting alone cannot validly decide the review.

issues.legal_issue: The municipal authority bears the burden of establishing that an existing assessment was incorrect by reason of fraud, misrepresentation or mistake before amending it on that basis.
material_facts: A periodical revisional assessment had been made, and a later amendment based on additions to the premises had also been made.
The authority later further amended the valuation and assessment on the basis that the earlier assessment was incorrect.

The authority did not establish that the earlier assessment was incorrect by reason of fraud, misrepresentation or mistake; it also failed to produce relevant assessment records despite an order for their discovery.
issues.conclusion: The authority had not established the precondition for reassessment, so the impugned reassessment could not stand.
issues.legal_principle: Section 107(1)(c) of the Bihar and Orissa Municipal Act, 1922 permits an amendment for an incorrect valuation or assessment only when the incorrectness resulted from fraud, misrepresentation or mistake. The burden of establishing that condition rests on the Commissioners, not on the taxpayer. No earlier cases are cited.

predicates.municipal_assessment_amendment_proceedin: The proceeding concerns an authority's amendment of an existing municipal assessment.
predicates.amendment_based_on_prior_assessment_erro: The authority sought to amend the assessment on the ground that the earlier valuation or assessment was incorrect.
predicates.assessing_authority_failed_to_prove_qual: The authority did not establish that the earlier assessment was incorrect because of fraud, misrepresentation or mistake.

issues.definition: An amendment based on an alleged error in an existing municipal assessment is invalid when the authority fails to establish the qualifying cause of that error.
